programme.desc: Two women, friends and of the same age Mi Seon and Do Gyeong, might be used to struggling in the most dangerous part of Seoul's Gangnam district, but that doesn't mean they've settled into it. With no one but each other to rely on, the two friends grind away to save the money needed to leave their dangerous lifestyles behind. But just as “retirement” comes within reach, the world betrays them, shattering their hopes. On the edge of a dead end, they discover a hidden fortune of dirty cash and gold in Gangnam – and place all their bets on one final high-stakes gamble of a lifetime. programme.title: Hit and Run Squad [English Subtitle]

The second-in-command of the IA team, Lieutenant Eun Shi-yeon, is relegated to the Hit and Run Squad at Inchon PD. She meets Squad Captain Woo and constable Seo Min-jae, who has an instinct for cars and a delinquent past. Eun also gets acquainted with Seo's family, who have met through car accidents. A hit-and-run case leads the squad to Jung as a prime suspect, Eun conducts a separate operation to acquire the black box in Jung's concept car. Jung, a reckless speed freak, chases Eun, leading to a tragic accident costing someone's life. When Eun discovers the dirty deal behind her back, she cooperates with Seo to finally bring justice to Jung.

programme.title: TAI CHI HERO [English Dub]
